```
figdown 0.1 block
title "Storage cluster monitoring tap"

group cluster "Storage cluster"
node n1 "Node 1" in=cluster
node n2 "Node 2" in=cluster
node tap "Monitoring tap"
node collector "Metrics collector"
node archiver "Archiver"

edge n1 -> n2
edge tap -> collector
edge collector -> archiver

pin cluster at=(0,0)
pin n1 at=(0,0) width=120 height=50
pin n2 at=(140,0) width=120 height=50
pin tap at=(60,60) width=80 height=30
```
